story_type: helicopter hoist beside a cruise ship in heavy seas, infrared
hook: 231 miles out, a helicopter hovered beside a rolling cruise ship.
narration: Two hundred thirty one miles out at sea, a helicopter hung beside a cruise ship over churning water.
A woman on board had to get to a hospital, and land was hours away.
Its crew from Elizabeth City eased the Jayhawk in beside the stern, with a Coast Guard Hercules covering them from above.
Over a ship, the pilot cannot see straight down, so the crew member at the door talks him into position, foot by foot.
The rescue basket swung below the Jayhawk in its own rotor wash.
[short pause] The crew took her family member along too.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew flew the woman and her family member to New Hanover Regional Hospital in Wilmington.

location_card.place: 231 miles southeast of Wilmington, North Carolina

title: Hoisted off a cruise ship 231 miles out
description:
On Nov. 19, 2021, Coast Guard aircrews from Air Station Elizabeth City medevaced a woman from a cruise ship about 231 miles southeast of Wilmington, North Carolina, while an HC-130 Hercules provided coverage.
